"""Fresh dated-publication replay from complete fixed inputs on this volume."""
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from common import BASE,REGEX,REPAIR,REVISION,SCOPE,need,pin,save

ROOT=Path('.artifacts/observer-value-profile-boundaries-20261010/publication-checkpoint')
PREFIXES=['docs/tasks',str(REGEX),str(REPAIR),'docs/TASK_TREE.md','doctrine/live_document_size/surfaces.jsonl']


def main():
    listing=['git','--no-replace-objects','ls-tree','-r','--name-only',REVISION,'--',*PREFIXES]
    result=subprocess.run(listing,capture_output=True,text=True)
    need(result.returncode==0 and result.stderr=='','whole fixed dated-publication input membership')
    names=result.stdout.splitlines()
    need(names and len(names)==len(set(names)),'complete distinct fixed checkpoint members')
    need(not ROOT.exists(),'retain complete first checkpoint workspace')
    ROOT.mkdir(parents=True)
    members={}
    for name in names:
        path=Path(name)
        need(not path.is_absolute() and '..' not in path.parts,'repository-relative checkpoint member')
        command=['git','--no-replace-objects','show',REVISION+':'+name]
        source=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True)
        need(source.returncode==0 and source.stderr==b'','whole fixed checkpoint byte retrieval')
        target=ROOT/path
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        target.write_bytes(source.stdout)
        members[name]=dict(identity=pin(source.stdout),command=command,status=source.returncode)
    before={str(p.relative_to(ROOT)):pin(p.read_bytes()) for p in ROOT.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
    need(before=={name:row['identity'] for name,row in members.items()},'whole copied checkpoint matches fixed Git inputs')
    command=['python3','-B',str(REPAIR/'verify.py')]
    actual=subprocess.run(command,cwd=ROOT.resolve(),capture_output=True,text=True)
    after={str(p.relative_to(ROOT)):pin(p.read_bytes()) for p in ROOT.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
    record=dict(revision=REVISION,cwd=str(ROOT),members=members,listing=dict(command=listing,status=result.returncode,
        stdout=result.stdout,stderr=result.stderr),command=command,status=actual.returncode,stdout=actual.stdout,
        stderr=actual.stderr,before=before,after=after,scope=SCOPE,
        meaning='Actual fresh execution against whole immutable committed inputs; no current mutable task state or borrowed result is admitted as the dated publication epoch.')
    save('checkpoint-publication.json',record)
    need(type(actual.returncode) is int and actual.returncode==0 and actual.stderr=='' and actual.stdout.startswith('PASS '),
         'actual fresh dated publication checkpoint success')
    need(before==after,'dated reader conserves every complete checkpoint input and creates no artifact')
    print('PASS fresh complete dated-publication checkpoint execution, fixed Git byte custody and before/after input conservation; no original native scope is promoted.')


if __name__=='__main__':
    main()

"""Complete external gate receipts; expected diagnostics remain visible."""
import json
import fcntl
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from common import BASE, canonical, need, pin


if __name__ == '__main__':
    need(len(sys.argv)>=3, 'named check and explicit command')
    name,command=sys.argv[1],sys.argv[2:]
    path=BASE/'checks.json'
    lock_path=Path('.artifacts/observer-value-profile-boundaries-20261010/checks.lock')
    lock_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    with lock_path.open('a+b') as lock:
        fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX)
        saved=json.loads(path.read_bytes()) if path.exists() else {}
        need(name not in saved, 'retain first complete check result')
    inputs={str(p):pin(p.read_bytes()) for p in sorted(BASE.glob('*.py'))}
    inputs.update({arg:pin(Path(arg).read_bytes()) for arg in command if Path(arg).is_file()})
    result=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,text=True)
    # Commands may run independently; only this short read/merge/write is
    # serialized. Reload after the child so an older invocation cannot erase
    # a receipt completed while it was running.
    with lock_path.open('a+b') as lock:
        fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX)
        saved=json.loads(path.read_bytes()) if path.exists() else {}
        need(name not in saved, 'retain first complete check result')
        saved[name]=dict(command=command,status=result.returncode,stdout=result.stdout,stderr=result.stderr,inputs=inputs)
        path.write_bytes(canonical(saved))
    print(name,result.returncode,result.stdout[-1400:],result.stderr[-1800:],flush=True)
    need(type(result.returncode) is int and result.returncode==0,'external check success: '+name)

"""Join fresh successes with exact dated-context replay, retaining first rejection."""
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from common import BASE,REVISION,SCOPE,canonical,load,need,pin,save
import prerequisites


def main():
    failed=load('actual-prerequisites-1.json')
    need(type(failed['status']) is int and failed['status']!=0 and failed['stderr'],
         'complete first wrong-context prerequisite result retained')
    readers=prerequisites.readers()
    result={}
    for name,arguments in readers.items():
        record=load('actual-prerequisite-'+name+'-1.json')
        need(record['command']==['python3','-B',*arguments],'complete exact first prerequisite command')
        if name=='regex-publication-repair':
            need(type(record['status']) is int and record['status']!=0
                 and ('entire independently measured final task declaration' in record['stderr']
                      or 'whole owning task and unchanged acceptance' in record['stderr']),
                 'dated current-publication reader rejects a changed task epoch')
            checkpoint=load('checkpoint-publication.json')
            need(type(checkpoint['status']) is int and checkpoint['status']==0 and checkpoint['stderr']==''
                 and checkpoint['stdout'].startswith('PASS ') and checkpoint['revision']==REVISION
                 and checkpoint['command']==record['command'] and checkpoint['before']==checkpoint['after'],
                 'actual fresh exact committed-context publication reader success')
            result[name]=dict(context='complete fixed committed inputs',receipt='checkpoint-publication.json',
                identity=pin(canonical(checkpoint)),first_wrong_context=pin(canonical(record)))
        else:
            need(type(record['status']) is int and record['status']==0 and record['stderr']==''
                 and 'PASS ' in record['stdout'],'complete fresh current source/value prerequisite success')
            result[name]=dict(context='current fixed source inputs',receipt='actual-prerequisite-'+name+'-1.json',
                identity=pin(canonical(record)))
    fixed={}
    for path in prerequisites.inputs():
        command=['git','--no-replace-objects','show',REVISION+':'+str(path)]
        actual=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True)
        need(actual.returncode==0 and actual.stderr==b'' and actual.stdout==path.read_bytes(),
             'whole fixed/current complete prerequisite input')
        fixed[str(path)]=dict(command=command,status=actual.returncode,identity=pin(actual.stdout))
    save('prerequisites-qualified.json',dict(revision=REVISION,readers=result,fixed=fixed,scope=SCOPE,
        context_contract='Every source/value reader executes fresh on current fixed source inputs; the dated publication reader executes fresh against every committed input at its exact epoch. The wrong current-task-context result remains a rejection and supplies no success.'))
    print('PASS complete fresh prerequisite set with distinct current-source and exact dated-publication contexts; first wrong-context result retains.')


if __name__=='__main__':
    main()

"""Join complete qualified values and explicit boundaries before opaque intake."""
from common import BASE,CENSUS,PREDICATE,SCALAR,REGEX,SCOPE,canonical,load,need,pin,read,save


def key(path):
    return tuple(path)


def source_product(source,census,predicate,scalar,regex,regex_plan):
    predicates={key(r['path']):i for i,r in enumerate(predicate['rows'])}
    scalars={key(r['path']):i for i,r in enumerate(scalar['members'])}
    regexes={key(r['path']):i for i,r in enumerate(regex['members'])}
    authored={r['helper']:r for r in regex['authored']}
    operands=[]
    for row in census['operands']:
        path,operand,schema=row['path'],row['input'],row['schema']
        if key(path) in predicates:
            index=predicates[key(path)]; value=predicate['rows'][index]
            need(value['input']==operand,'complete original predicate/source operand join')
            qualification=dict(kind='qualified whole guard construction',source_row=index,
                source_row_identity=pin(canonical(value)),defined=value['defined'],string_value=value['string_value'],
                numeric_value=value['numeric_value'],source_expression=value['source_expression'],
                original_native_scalar_flags=value['original_native_scalar_flags'],
                meaning='Source guard determines the value; a declared logical zero field is not an encoded-token oracle.')
        elif schema in ('scalar','context_scalar'):
            index=scalars[key(path)]; member=scalar['members'][index]
            need(member['operand']==operand and member['schema']==schema,'whole scalar member/source/schema join')
            value=scalar['values'][member['value']]
            qualification=dict(kind='qualified complete scalar value',source_member=index,
                value_id=member['value'],value=value['value'],constructor=value['constructor'],
                evidence_role=member['evidence_role'],original_native_scalar_flags='not measured')
        elif schema=='regex_source':
            index=regexes[key(path)]; member=regex['members'][index]
            need(member['operand']==operand,'whole regex member/source role join')
            recipe=authored[member['helper']]
            qualification=dict(kind='qualified whole authored regex',source_member=index,helper=member['helper'],
                authored=recipe,current_cases=[r for r in regex_plan['cases'] if r['body']==recipe['body']],
                original_native_flags_encoding='not measured',original_regexp_provider_identity='not measured')
        else:
            need(schema in ('reference','context_reference'),'closed remaining reference boundary schema')
            qualification=dict(kind='source reference role and kind only',reference_kind=operand['reference_kind'],
                original_address_identity_flags_referent='not measured',current_fixture_borrowing='forbidden')
        operands.append(dict(path=path,schema=schema,input=operand,qualification=qualification))
    phases=[]
    for m,mode in enumerate(source['modes']):
        for c,case in enumerate(mode['cases']):
            for p,phase in enumerate(case['phases']):
                public=phase['public']
                need(public['historical_profile']=='unmeasured' and public['source_operator']=='do',
                     'whole original profile and source do boundary')
                need(public['load']=='require ./t/1986-isf-record-port-value-gates.t'
                     and phase['own']['load']==public['load'],'source do versus whole diagnostic require marker')
                phases.append(dict(path=['modes',m,'cases',c,'phases',p],mode=mode['mode'],domain=case['domain'],
                    index=case['index'],phase=p,source_public=public,source_phase={k:v for k,v in phase.items() if k not in ('own','public')},
                    original_settings_formatter='unmeasured',receiver_contents_class_identity='unmeasured',
                    private_framework_eval_meaning='unmeasured',diagnostic_marker_changes_source_operator=False))
    operand_positions={key(r['path']):i for i,r in enumerate(operands)}
    phase_positions={key(r['path']):i for i,r in enumerate(phases)}
    obligations={}
    for name,paths in census['obligations'].items():
        obligations[name]=[dict(path=path,resolution_kind='operand' if key(path) in operand_positions else 'phase',
            resolution_index=(operand_positions if key(path) in operand_positions else phase_positions)[key(path)]) for path in paths]
    return dict(scope=SCOPE,operands=operands,phases=phases,obligations=obligations,loads=census['loads'],
        source_scope=source['scope'],historical_scope=source['frame_model']['historical'],
        predicate_public_profile=predicate['current_profile'],predicate_original_settings=predicate['original_observer_settings'],
        regex_public_profile=regex_plan['profile'],
        dependencies={str(path):pin(path.read_bytes()) for path in [CENSUS/'source-models.json',CENSUS/'census.json',
            PREDICATE/'predicate-values-qualified.json',SCALAR/'scalars.json',REGEX/'regexes.json',REGEX/'plan.json']})


def main():
    product=source_product(read(CENSUS/'source-models.json'),read(CENSUS/'census.json'),
        read(PREDICATE/'predicate-values-qualified.json'),read(SCALAR/'scalars.json'),read(REGEX/'regexes.json'),read(REGEX/'plan.json'))
    need(not (BASE/'opaque-evidence.json').exists(),'complete source hypotheses before own opaque-evidence attachment')
    save('source-products.json',product)
    save('source-selection.json',dict(scope=SCOPE,opaque_evidence_present=False,
        product=pin(canonical(product)),programs={str(p):pin(p.read_bytes()) for p in sorted(BASE.glob('*.py'))}))
    print('PASS complete qualified source values, original obligation allocation and explicit opaque/profile boundaries before own opaque attachment.')


if __name__=='__main__':
    main()

import subprocess
from common import BASE,CENSUS,PREDICATE,SCALAR,REGEX,REPAIR,REVISION,SCOPE,canonical,module,need,pin,save
from run import execute


def inputs():
    return [CENSUS/'census.json',CENSUS/'source-models.json',CENSUS/'obligation-plan.json',
        PREDICATE/'predicate-values-qualified.json',PREDICATE/'manifest-final.json',
        SCALAR/'scalars.json',SCALAR/'qualified-proof.json',SCALAR/'manifest-qualified.json',
        REGEX/'regexes.json',REGEX/'plan.json',REGEX/'proof.json',REGEX/'manifest.json',
        REPAIR/'proof.json',REPAIR/'manifest.json']


def readers():
    result=dict(module(PREDICATE/'common.py')['READERS'])
    result['predicate-values']=[str(PREDICATE/'verify.py')]
    result['scalar-values']=[str(SCALAR/'verify.py')]
    result['regex-values']=[str(REGEX/'verify.py')]
    result['regex-publication-repair']=[str(REPAIR/'verify.py')]
    return result


def main():
    fixed={}
    for path in inputs():
        command=['git','--no-replace-objects','show',REVISION+':'+str(path)]
        result=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True)
        need(result.returncode==0 and not result.stderr and result.stdout==path.read_bytes(),
             'whole fixed/current value boundary prerequisite')

        readers={name:pin(canonical(record)) for name,record in receipts.items()},scope=SCOPE))

"""Retain every actual command, stream and complete program epoch, including failures."""
import subprocess
import sys
from common import BASE, canonical, need, pin, save


def execute(label, command):
    previous = list(BASE.glob('actual-' + label + '-*.json'))
    name = 'actual-' + label + '-' + str(len(previous) + 1) + '.json'
    programs = {str(p):dict(identity=pin(p.read_bytes()), body=p.read_text())
                for p in sorted(BASE.iterdir()) if p.suffix in ('.py', '.pl')}
    result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True)
    record = dict(command=command, status=result.returncode, stdout=result.stdout,
                  stderr=result.stderr, programs=programs)
    save(name, record)
    print(name, result.returncode, result.stdout[-500:], result.stderr[-1000:], flush=True)
    need(type(result.returncode) is int and result.returncode == 0 and not result.stderr,
         'actual complete successful step: ' + name)
    return record


if __name__ == '__main__':
    need(len(sys.argv) >= 3, 'label and explicit command required')
    execute(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2:])
